versions.title: Dia Tune-ups v1.1.1
changes: Fix: Developer-mode toolbar icons and the striped tab mark no longer disappear off-hover. The dev state now stays latched through Dia's transient toolbar hover rebuilds, and the trailing toolbar is kept opaque while the toolbar is present.
One-click Updates: The Tune-ups panel's update card is now a single Update Tune-ups button that checks GitHub, reports what was found, and pulls + rebuilds automatically.

Smarter Update Detection: New builds are detected by comparing the local git commit with the latest commit on master, so an update is found even when no GitHub release was published or the version wasn't bumped.
No Console Windows: The in-panel updater, update scripts, and the new diatweaks.vbs launcher run without opening a CMD window.
Patch Dia however it's opened is now on by default.
Window Material Translucency Slider: A new slider under Window material sets how far the space colour fades while the sidebar is open.
Developer Mode: Tab-switch guard stops the dev mark/toolbar jumping to a tab the user just switched to; toolbar icons pick light or dark from the real on-screen toolbar colour.

versions.title: Dia Tune-ups v1.1.0
changes: In-App Tune-ups Settings: Full settings page inside Dia with live toggle switches and preset picker.
Developer Mode Toolbar: Arc-style dev toolbar with responsive inspect, console, network, and extension tools.
Peek Link Preview: Preview links in floating cards with customizable shortcuts (Shift+click, Hold, Ctrl+Shift, Alt) and animations (Genie, Ease, Zoom).
Tactile Sidebar Textures: Procedural Sand, Fine Grain, Denim weave, and Paper fiber textures with intensity and softness sliders.
Window Backdrop Materials: Native Windows 11 Mica, Mica Alt, and Acrylic backdrops with edge-to-edge frameless geometry.
Daily Painting Wallpaper: Automatic daily fine-art wallpaper on the New Tab page with curated artwork metadata.
Segoe UI Variable Typography: Optional toggle to force Windows 11 Segoe UI Variable font for UI and web content.
Clean Search Box: Streamlined single-line New Tab and Command Bar (Ctrl+T / Ctrl+L).
Profile Emoji: Display custom emojis instead of space dots in the space switcher.
Update Checker & Changelog: In-panel update checking, release notes viewer, and Buy Me a Coffee support card.
